comment: She assigned a lot of homework every class. The movies were a good representation of francophone cinema, but she could be more well-versed in cultures that weren't French. She was available to meet, but she encouraged students to strive for success by putting down students from previous classes, conveying that she expected us to fail

French 221 is going to be hard no matter the prof, and Dr. Baker is definitely not the easiest, but also not the hardest. She cares a lot about her students and gives clear grading criteria. LOTS of hw, 6 exams, and a big project, but there are so many grades, so doing badly on one thing won't kill you. Participate and pay attention!!

I have learned so much for this class. With that being said, it is intense. There is homework every night with homework checks. Participation matters and is taken daily. But, if you need help, she is always willing to meet in office hours and give feedback. If you want an A you need to pay attention and do the work, but it is attainable.
Would take if you want to learn french, would not take if you want an easy A

I felt that Dr. Baker was one of the few Professors at this University who truly cared about me. Her passion for teaching French and sharing French Culture can feel overwhelming, but it's because she cares about her work. More importantly, she cares about you.

great prof for FREN 121 and really any grammar class, but I wouldn't recommend her for anything but that. 221 with her had a lot of busywork. She's also the type of prof to talk a bit of trash about her class (which has been overheard by classmates in the past). Overall, not the worst and you will leave better at French, but also not the best.

Overall, Professor Baker is an amazing professor, who clearly cares about French culture and language. However, the classes she teaches can be pretty intensive and lecture heavy; however, if you go to office hours and commit your time to learning, you should have a good grade no matter what.

A TOUGH prof, with lots of work - but gives lots of helpful feedback. Arguably hardest French class at Richmond. However, if you put in the work, you will be rewarded. Unbelievably kind and caring prof and her knowledge of French grammar is impressive. Open to meeting with students and wants all to succeed. Great prof for upper level French/majors

French 121 & 221 are both super difficult and require pretty much all your time & effort to do well in them. There is quite a lot of material covered on each test-- make sure to spend ample time studying everything. Classes were taught almost all in French, making things even more difficult. French might become your life if you take the class.

Lots of homework but if you put in the work you rarely need to study. She's very good at preparing you for the tests, does review sessions in class. Super open to questions and occasionally allows corrections on tests and essays. Still, it's a lot of work, so be ready.

Really helped with my French. She was engaging during class and expected students to participate. There was a good amount of homework, but she was understanding if I needed extra time. She had close relationships with all the students and worked on helping each develop their French individually. Class itself was super fun. One of my favorite profs.
Very difficult class and Baker is very intimidating and can feel condescending. I recognize French 121 is just a difficult class but she tries to make it worse. A lot of work for not much reward.

Really nice and helpful, and definitely cares about her students. If you put a lot of work in and talk to her she will really help you learn, and you get what you put in. Very picky grader though and will mark many points off for every single error. Still, that level of pickiness really helps you learn and fix mistakes. Would take again maybe.

Dr. Baker isn't respectful toward many of her students, especially if they aren't naturally good at her subject but still are dedicated, diligent students who are at least okay at French. The workload is incredibly unrealistic and she has no regard for the wellbeing of her students. Many of my peers and I avoid her classes at all costs.

She is definitely difficult getting used to, but as long as you do what she tells you, your grades would be fine. She is quite strict about accents, and I recommend doing extra curricular exercises like films and videos to improve.

Definitely expects a lot from her students, but is also willing to put in the work to make sure each student is reaching their full potential. Makes an effort to keep class engaging and use a variety of teaching styles. Lots of opportunities for extra credit. Work hard and an A is possible.

Attendance and textbooks are critical. Homework every night, and random checked. Definitely a tough grader but gives clear instructions and good feedback. Participation matters for a good grade. Pronunciation is super important to her and she's super critical of it. Overall, learned so much and improved a lot in my French!

This class is great if you really want to learn French, but you will work for it. Theres lots of homework and written assignments but she gives good feedback and really wants to see her students improve. Dont take this if you have other really hard classes because she will call you out for not putting in enough effort.
Would not recommend her class!

I am currently taking French with Prof. Baker, and she is honestly the best professor I have had. She puts in so much effort into making each of her students succeed. Although she is a tough grader, you learn tons from her. In a few months I was able to learn from her more than I had learned in four years combined.
Professor Baker is difficult but puts in so much time and effort- you will learn a ton from her!

Expects a lot of time and effort be put into her course. Many students come into the course thinking that it will just be an easy film studies course, but her high expectations definitely cause her students to greatly improve in French fluency and vocab. She is not a soft grader, but she is fair. LOTS of work, but one of favorite courses!

tough prof but really wants students to succeed. Homework every night and randomly graded, tests  are difficult and speaking is required, overall she is very helpful and wants you to do well, you just have to put in a lot of work.

Got a lot more work than I expected from this class. Lots of homework and she can be a pretty tough grader. Participation matters a lot. Oral presentation project, oral midterm and another oral presentation final. Regret taking it

Dr. Baker is the best of the best. If you want to learn a lot of French in only two semesters, take her for 121 and 221. You have to pay attention and do the homework, but you'll get out what you put in.

Dr. Baker gives a lot of homework and has really high expectations, but she's also really dedicated to helping her students succeed and do well. I had zero French knowledge coming into the class but she made it so easy to pick up. There's a lot of work involved, but she's a really excellent professor.

I've never written a rate my professor before but I feel like I need to let students know that French 221 with Dr. Baker was the hardest class I've ever taken and I've taken ACCT 302 with Dr. Hoyle. Dr. Baker gives tons of homework every night and you will fail this class with out putting in a lot of effort.

Really great teacher, one of the best I've ever had. I took her for two semesters of intensive French so I really got to know her. She can be a bit intimidating at first but she really wants her students to succeed. Don't take her class if you don't want to work, but it if you really want to learnFrench she's the one. Really learn so much, amazing!
She is the best professor I've had while at Richmond. Very fun and enthusiastic about learning.
She's a good teacher and cares a lot... too much. Very intense but seems worth it, you will learn a lot, but you will get frustrated with her a lot also.

At the end of my semester with her I was exhausted. She expects a lot, but gives you a lot of opportunities. She not easy by any means. Still, having started my second semester with French, with a supposedly easier teacher, I miss her. She was very clear about her expectations, and you never worried that one bad test would kill your final grade.
Fantastic teacher! Very knowledgeable of French. Definitely pushes students to do a lot of work and learn the material. Homework is easy but it is every day so keeping up is essential.

An incredibly smart teacher who really cares about her students. I had no French background coming into the course and, even though I did not do as well as I'd hoped, I am still proud of what I accomplished. Expect workbook/textbook homework every night (it's manageable).

Dr. Baker is a great teacher but does not suffer fools.  I went into this class hating French, but I learned to tolerate it.  She is pretty hard gives a lot of work but is fair.  She is also very easy on the eyes, which is nice when you have to see her five days a week.

I LOVED her! She is very enthusiastic and extremely helpful. She does SO many things to make the class more interesting...it wasn't all about learning vocabulary and grammar. She taught us a lot about the French culture as well. Prior to this class, I wasn't sure I wanted to continue with French, but now I am planning on majoring or minoring in it!
She is a great teacher and will help you out and give you every opportunity to excel, even if she knows French isn't your thing. She is highly recommended, especially if you have to take 221 anyway.

Made a class that was supposed to be easygoing and fun incredibly intense.  She gave us this huge final project without telling us what she wanted and ended up having us redo the whole thing using her own ideas.  If you approach her she's helpful but that can't save everything.

I was very interested in French coming into the class, but when the class started becoming more intensive, and more difficult, her willingness to help was non existent. She actually encouraged students to get out when times got tough rather than encouraging them to work through it, or offer ways to help.

Dr. Baker is really great... she can be a little intense sometimes but I took more from her class than I did from most of my other courses. The daily work can be a bit annoying... but thats the same with all language courses. The class itself isn't hard, but attendance is mandatory. I'll definitely take another class with her if I get the chance.
She is sooooooo damn fine.  By far the best looking teacher at richmond

Dr. Baker is one of the most organized teachers i have ever had.She returns all assignments in a timely fashion,is incredibly helpful and is very responsive to emails.I would definately recommend taking her class even though she is strict.I took French because i needed to fulfill the language requirement but because of her i plan to major in it.

The class isn't too hard, but she plays favorites. If you are not one of her favorites, she has a bias against you. Being on time is considered late. Grading seems a bit arbitrary at times, but the class isn't too hard.
Awesome. Knows what she's talking about. Do the homework, speak in class, and you'll have no problem at all.
Dr. Baker is very well organized and this organization transfers to her students who know what is coming/what to expect.  I plan to take more of her classes in the future.

Dont take any upperlevel class with her. She thinks her class is the only class you take and that you do nothing else. She has her favourites which means she is not always fair. She can make your life miserable.
Lots of work, hard grader, but DEFINITELY worth it.  If you really want to learn French, she will get you there!

Fantastic teacher. I learned so much in such a short period of time. She's extremely organized and doesn't stray from the syllabus. Her class was intense, but definitely worth it. I would definitely recommend her!
Her class was really entertaining and she's very nice and and a great teacher - I highly recommend her!
Very demanding, very strict, checks almost daily to make sure you do your homework.  She assigns WAY too much homework. At the same time, she's very helpful outside of class.
amazing professor!  demanding but fun.
No Comments
I was a drill instructor for her.  Very strict, very demanding.  so much more organized than any other french professor.
Assigns a lot of homework, but her tests are easy and her class are entertaining...definetely take her
Helpful, friendly, but slightly demanding.  I've learned more in this French class than any other at UR
Excellent professor...fun, knowledgable, enthusiastic.  Assigns a lot of time-consuming work though.
